data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Muru' meaning moon and 'Salim' meaning protector. The name Mursalim signifies a person who protects and nurtures like the moon in the night sky. The name Mursalim carries the meaning “Moon Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Mursalim usually hope their child will grow to embody moon protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
